content.value_statement: Writing a complete PR description can slow down final review. This skill reads local branch context and produces a structured title and description.
actual_capabilities: Collects local git status, commit history, changed files, and diffs for the current branch.
Summarizes modified components, change purpose, impact, and testing needs.
Generates a PR description with Summary, Changes, Impact, Testing, and Notes sections.
Suggests a conventional commit style PR title based on the branch changes.
Reminds users about common follow-up steps such as pushing a branch or creating a PR.
limitations: Assumes the base branch is main unless the user or repository context indicates another branch.
Does not verify remote CI results unless those results are provided in the workspace or conversation.
May need user confirmation for large diffs, generated files, or private implementation details.
Does not create or submit the pull request by itself.

use_cases.title: Prepare feature PRs
use_cases.description: Create a clear PR title and description after implementing a feature branch.

use_cases.title: Standardize review notes
use_cases.description: Convert branch diffs into a consistent review summary before opening a pull request.

use_cases.title: Document maintenance changes
use_cases.description: Summarize dependency updates, refactors, or cleanup work with testing notes.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare this PR
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a complete PR description.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare the PR description for my current branch.

prompt_templates.title: Draft with known base
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a PR description for this branch compared with develop.

prompt_templates.title: Focus review impact
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare the PR and emphasize behavior changes, risks, and testing gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced release summary
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a polished description for a larger change set.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a release-ready PR description with a concise title, grouped changes, impact, testing status, and follow-up notes.

output_examples.input: Prepare the PR for my feature branch.
output_examples.output: Suggested title, a concise summary, grouped change bullets, impact notes, a testing checklist, and optional follow-up notes.

output_examples.input: Draft a PR against develop and call out risks.
output_examples.output: A comparison-based PR description that highlights changed modules, possible risks, validation status, and reviewer guidance.

output_examples.input: Write a PR description for dependency cleanup.
output_examples.output: A maintenance-focused PR summary with dependency changes, expected impact, test status, and clear notes for reviewers.

best_practices: Confirm the intended base branch before generating the final comparison.
Review the generated description for sensitive details before posting it to GitHub.
Update the testing checklist with commands that were actually run.
anti_patterns: Do not use the generated description without checking it against the real diff.
Do not include secrets, private customer data, or unrelated implementation details in the PR body.
Do not leave testing boxes checked unless the validation was completed.

faq.question: Does this skill create the pull request automatically?
faq.answer: No. It prepares the title and description, then reminds the user about optional next steps.

faq.question: Which base branch does it use?
faq.answer: It assumes main by default, but users can ask for another base branch.

faq.question: Can it summarize large diffs?
faq.answer: Yes, but very large changes may require focused prompts or user guidance.

faq.question: Does it run tests?
faq.answer: No. It includes testing fields and can report tests only when results are available.

faq.question: Can it follow a custom PR template?
faq.answer: The skill uses its built-in template unless the user provides a different required format.

faq.question: Is it limited to GitHub?
faq.answer: The wording references GitHub pull requests, but the summary can be adapted for similar review tools.
